summary: BitVentures Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, announcing it joined Foundry USA Pool to direct its Bitcoin mining hashrate to the pool's platform. No financial terms, stakes, or board recommendations were provided. The arrangement uses a Full-Pay-Per-Share payout model to reduce volatility. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. Non-US issuer using Rule 13a-16. No risk-arb angle exists.
